title: Great app, clean design
body: I've been looking for something like this for a while, and it's such a relief to find it in an app that's beautifully designed as well. The free version lets you try out how the app works, and the upgrade offers unlimited habits and scheduling. When you're looking to structure your life through your daily habits, it's wonderful to easily sort them by the time of day and day of the week. If you have habits you need to do such as check in on your monthly budget at the end of the month, the app allows you to schedule it for the start, middle or end of the month. That's useful. Will continue to use this and update!
